evasion_targets: paths::BENIGN_READERS keepass.exe (signer None, AllStores, any path)
notes: Trojanised KeePass (signed binary + malicious plugin / modified build, KeeLoader 2025) in a per-user folder reads every browser, wallet, Telegram and Discord store. keepass.exe is a BENIGN_READERS entry with no signer requirement and AllStores scope, so reads are dropped before ST-01/ST-02 and ST-04 never sees a credential read.
known_gap: keepass.exe is a BENIGN_READERS entry with signer None and AllStores scope: any validly signed keepass.exe anywhere reads everything silently
